hookText: POV: You caught the inn's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: I was scrubbing the hearth, my hands slick with soapy water, when I heard laughter. I peered around the corner, and there she was, the new girl, twirling in the dim light of the chandelier. Her gown clung to her fair skin, and her curls danced with the air as she moved. The tavern was abuzz, and whispers followed her footsteps.
caption:
The new girl's laughter set tongues wagging! What secrets does Betty hold in her diary? 🌟
